description: This file is a header file defining the interface for a command line interface (CLI) server and client, including function declarations, macros, and external variables related to CLI command processing.

methods.name: CLI_SERVER_UpdateSocketSet
methods.description: Updates the socket set for the CLI server.

methods.name: CLI_SERVER_ProcessSocketActivity
methods.description: Processes socket activity for the CLI server.

methods.name: CLI_SERVER_SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response string from the CLI server.

methods.name: CLI_SERVER_IsCmdRunLocally
methods.description: Checks if a CLI command should run locally.

methods.name: CLI_CLIENT_ExecCommand
methods.description: Executes a CLI command from the client side.
